sessionHistory.note: bd sync was blocked by the approval reviewer because the configured beads sync remote is an external git+ssh destination; I did not retry or work around it. The sandboxed npm test run failed with EPERM on child processes/socket binds, then the escalated npm test run passed. No plan deviations. Implemented squash-aware close-out verification by accepting a merged GitHub PR only when the feature branch tip predates mergedAt, preventing ancestry-only false positives after squash merge. Added lifecycle regression coverage. Gates: npx vitest run tests/unit/lib/lifecycle/workflows.test.ts; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test.

feedback.markdownBody:
# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-2260

Squash-merge verification trusts timestamps instead of proving the branch ref matches the merged PR head

## Required action

Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with:

`pan review request PAN-2260 -m "Fixed review issues"`
